tool.name: SplitSegmentsIntoSubclassFeatures
tool.summary: Split segment polylines into subsegments based on the subclass_rules JSON field. For each subclass rule, a new polyline feature is created covering the specified geometry fraction with the subclass field populated accordingly. Original features that have splits are replaced by the new subsegment features. Overlapping geometry fractions are handled by duplicating the overlapping portion.

usage.bullet_item: The input features must be polylines containing a subclass_rules text field with JSON-encoded subclass definitions from Overture Maps.
Features without subclass rules or with a single full-range rule are left unchanged.
If an Output Features path is provided, the input data is copied before splitting and the original features are not modified.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The polyline feature layer or feature class containing a subclass_rules field to use for splitting.

param.name: output_features
param.dialogReference: Optional output feature class. When provided, the input features are copied here before splitting and the original data is left untouched.
